trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. There is no shortcut: the platinum pops only when the last of the other 54 is earned, so work through the roadmap stages below and save the 100% gold for last.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end. It is the first mission of the game and cannot be missed — it pops as the story begins.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story progression only — it pops when the chapter ends, so just play through.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story progression only — it pops when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story progression only — it pops when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story progression only — it pops when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission (Chapter 5). It pops when the story ends. Keep a manual save before it — several guides advise saving at the start of every chapter and once more before the final mission, in case you want to mop up afterwards.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Story progression — it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Story progression — it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story progression — it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story progression — it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Story progression — it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story progression — it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the hardest trophy: it needs the story finished plus the full in-game checklist — activities, collectibles and challenges. Both KeenGamer and EGamers rank it the hardest of the 55, so leave it for last, after the story and the cleanup stages, and use the in-game checklist to find what is left.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts are jumps, near-misses and airtime; they add up across the whole map, so do them as you travel rather than in one session.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The game counts a type the first time you try it — sample every activity (races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, bowling and the rest) rather than mastering one.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Gold each of the 42 range challenges; practice the weapon types you are weakest at and retry a challenge until it turns gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Win at least one drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun spots around Leonida.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Each race counts once, so win 20 distinct races rather than repeating one.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and beat him at fishing — watch the line tension and reel him in when he tires.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade game through to its end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Finish Andy's mission strand — the trophy pops at his last mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's mission strand — the trophy pops at his last mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's mission strand — the trophy pops at his last mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Find and finish 8 stranger mission strands scattered around the state — look for the strangers marked on the map as you explore.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's mission strand — the trophy pops at his last mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's mission strand — the trophy pops at his last mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. This is the one trophy guides flag as possibly missable: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 counts toward it and disappears after that chapter, and there is no mission replay. Meditate at the balcony in Chapter 1, then at every other spot as you find them — and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Track down the one animal Bret asks for and hunt it — it is a single, named target, not a random hunt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find the cards hidden around Leonida and finish three full sets — collect them as you explore rather than hunting them all at once.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app at 100 different spots — it adds up as you explore, so use it everywhere you go.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Work through the game's challenges; they accumulate across activities, so keep chipping at them as you play.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a 4-star wanted level while playing with your partner, then break line of sight and escape together — do it in open country where you can lose the cops.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob three shops in a row with your partner and keep the wanted level from dropping between them — plan a route of three close shops and move fast.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Find and get into 100 different vehicles — new models count as you encounter them around Leonida, so try everything you see.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a firefight with at least five enemies close together and drop all five before it ends — pick a crowded fight.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). The description is the only confirmed detail so far — head to the airport and leave by a route that is not on the schedule. No guide has pinned down the exact exit yet.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos (tanks). The description hints at tanks — 'Rhinos' is the in-game tank. No guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet; it most likely involves a tank encounter, so keep an eye out while playing and expect a method to be confirmed soon after launch.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, go in quiet, take the goods and get out without any alarm or witness spotting you — a clean, silent job.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Rob five bank vaults and get away clean each time — plan the getaway before you go in.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit an armored truck on the road, take the cash and get away — a classic blitz.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Visit every one of the 52 named areas — the map fills in as you go, so use it to find the gaps and drive through the corners you have not seen.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Hit one illegal operation for each gang — nine gangs, nine robberies — and keep track of which gangs you have already hit.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Have a cocktail at a spot overlooking Ocean Beach. No guide has confirmed the exact bar yet — the description is the only confirmed detail so far.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Break out of a vehicle showroom by driving straight through it. The exact showroom is not yet confirmed.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Bowl at the Kolt & Associates alley — Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Play a full game there.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Raise both Jason's and Lucia's Strength attributes to maximum. Max out the Strength stat for both protagonists — build it through the activities that train it, and the trophy pops when both are at the top.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Your choices and actions feed the Criminal Profile; do 500 of them across the game. GTABase reports the count as 500, from a single source, so treat the number as the best current figure.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Trigger a hidden second-chance event. The description ('Second time's the charm') suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something. The exact method is unverified — no guide has confirmed it yet, so expect it to pop while you play.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. The description ('What the hell just happened?') points to a strange event in the world — a UFO-style encounter or an odd scene. No guide has confirmed the trigger yet.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by. Hit a target with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The precise method is still being confirmed — try it on a pedestrian from a slow-moving car.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Pass marked bills to your contacts until $250,000 is laundered — it accumulates, so keep feeding them as the bills come in.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in total at shops — it adds up across every purchase, so it comes naturally if you buy gear, clothes and cars as you play.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy every garage property available — save up and buy them as they appear on the market.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten vehicles you own in the Scooter Bros app — any ten will do.
